model.distinction: Rational responses and muzzle overrides are explicit gameplay damage calibration, not a claim that fixed energy transmission produces these curves.
model.unchanged: Every SI physical profile value: mass, muzzle speed, drag area, energy transmission and spread. Flight, physical slowdown and drop use those original values.

provenance.label: Refuge habituel avant le modèle physique
provenance.scope: Frozen live weapon settings; first unobstructed target, body hit, no armor or upgrades. Damage before clipping to remaining HP, except explicit ordinary Magnum example.

formulas.legacy: near until start; linear interpolation from near to far between start and end; far afterward
formulas.beyond30m: when longRangeDamage50 exists, interpolate legacyFalloff(30) to min(legacyFalloff(30), longRangeDamage50/damage) over 30..50m; constant afterward
formulas.sniper: longRangePenetration bypasses falloff; 350 damage until strict maximum range
formulas.maximumRange: bullet contact requires hitAt < weapon.range; zero at and beyond range
formulas.penetration: first target index=0: multiplier 1; no secondary-target damage included
formulas.headshots: excluded; old ordinary bullets used currentWaveBalance headshotMultiplier; Magnum oneShot ignored it
formulas.magnum: ordinary target HP is set to zero; bosses lose fixed 1000 HP; stored weapon.damage=200 was not actual zombie damage
formulas.rocket: distance from explosion center: damage through innerRadius inclusive, linear decrease to zero at radiusDamage; flight distance does not attenuate blast
formulas.flamethrower: direct contact DPS inside cone; separate burnDps and burnDuration not summed into direct DPS
formulas.melee: first target light or heavy damage within selected attack reach; no falloff or subsequent-target retention

baseline.definition: Frozen habitual Refuge on port 3002; first body impact, no armor, headshot, upgrade or prior penetration. Per projectile; Magnum table uses the boss rule.

predecessor.definition: Exact prior shipped profile literals are frozen inside the calibration script. The historical report remains unchanged.

policy.meanWeighting: Uniform continuous distance, not player shot frequency, hit probability, DPS or a crowd score.
policy.integralMethod: Three-point Gauss-Legendre separately on every legacy breakpoint; exact for the polynomial pieces, subject to floating-point rounding.
policy.rootMethod: Closed-form rational integrals and bracketed bisection, 90 iterations maximum; choose the low-amplitude rational root. Previous exponential-only proposal is retained for comparison.
policy.exceptions: Shotgun and sniper retain exponential shapes anchored at 10 m with small mean deficits; Magnum retains its complete approved 2000-PV muzzle profile.
errorSources: IEEE-754 rounding; old coefficients are themselves stored floating-point values.
Distance averages describe unobstructed first body damage, not gameplay encounter frequency or shotgun pellet contact probability.
Gameplay damage is separated from the physical energy curve; all projectile flight parameters are preserved.
Previous/current damage samples beyond the physical horizon are theoretical curve values, with currentReachable false. The old samples are zero beyond their old hard ranges.
Magnum ordinary forced kills are not a finite legacy damage curve; matching boss 1000 would abandon the approved 2000 muzzle choice.
No human playtest, multiplayer validation or performance claim is established by this calculation.

feasibility.note: Ratios below this minimum have no nonnegative-drag solution; nonflat feasible ratios below one have two roots. Zero-drag plateau or steep second roots can satisfy aggregates while harming weapon roles.

kernelAgreement.note: Kernel receives generated profiles explicitly; the report does not depend on the mutable imported profile table.
